_source: Built-in claude.ai Google Drive connector. Input schemas are taken from its tool definitions. Output shapes were observed 2026-10-16 with read-only calls (Seb approved). Field names and structure only; values below are type placeholders.
_notes: Outputs are a flattened File shape, not raw Drive v3 resources: title (not name), owner (email string, not owners[]), parentId (first parent, not parents[]), fileSize (string; also present on Google-native files), viewUrl (= webViewLink), resourceUri.
contentSnippet is present unless excludeContentSnippets is set. Drive v3 has no snippets; ours come from the start of a plain-text export of Google-native files (see PLAN §4d).
fileExtension is present for non-native files only.
Our tools add: account and accountEmail on every item; de-duplicated files also carry accounts[] and sources[]; plus top-level accountErrors[] and nextCursor, which replaces nextPageToken.

download_file_content.mimeType: string (the exported type for native files, e.g. text/plain)
download_file_content.title: string

create_file: File (from the tool description; not observed, since creating is a write)
copy_file: File (from the tool description; not observed)
